name: Hierarchical Communication Traffic Sankey
description: A pure hierarchical communication Sankey rendered as a signal field. Rank rails expand into configured child endpoints such as Expert, Token Group, AIC, AIV, or Unattributed; spectral ribbons cross a fabric gate while product chrome, metrics, legends, and timeline panels remain outside the pattern.
whyExistingIsInsufficient: Memory architecture patterns explain physical topology but cannot express many-to-many rank traffic, conservation, routing skew, or source-to-destination attribution.

encoding.ribbonWidth: sum(event.value or event.bytes) for events whose start timestamp is in the selected window
encoding.ribbonGradientStart: source rank, or gray when the expanded source endpoint is Unattributed
encoding.ribbonGradientEnd: destination rank, or gray when the expanded destination endpoint is Unattributed
encoding.ribbonTransition: direct interpolation from source-rank color to destination-rank color without a forced white midpoint
encoding.nodeHeight: aggregated send or receive value in the active primaryMeasure
encoding.rankHeader: collapsed and expanded states share one title/detail typography, text anchor, and side-relative position; expansion only changes the chevron and reveals the rail and children
encoding.childEndpoint: configured Expert, Token Group, AIC, AIV, or Unattributed hierarchy
encoding.capacityMarker: current child value divided by configured capacity limit
encoding.fabricGate: a visual crossing plane, not a transfer node

forbiddenOverrides: embedding product titles, KPIs, provenance badges, legends, timeline controls, or explanatory copy inside the pattern root
using glow or gradients to alter the byte-proportional ribbon boundary
reducing an entire aggregated ribbon's opacity because it contains some unattributed events
recreating the Sankey geometry in a consuming page
treating Rank-to-child expansion as a physical transfer hop
agentReuseRule: Load the shared pattern.css and pattern.js, mount one empty container, and let the shared SVG renderer own all graph internals. Product panels may control the window or consume selection callbacks but must remain sibling surfaces.
mockBoundary: The repository supports the multi-rank problem and AllToAllv contract, but preview timestamps, measures, durations, child correlations, and capacity values are mock. Production data must preserve missing correlations as Unattributed and missing capacity as missing.
previewGate: Approved by user on 2026-08-03 for registration and product consumption.
